abs-cond-sums.alt: Partial sums for N = 1 to 20. Open dots: the harmonic series, the sum of 1 over n, climbing steadily to about 3.60 with no ceiling. Filled dots: the alternating harmonic series, zigzagging around a dashed line at about 0.693. The alternating series converges but the series of absolute values diverges: conditional convergence.
